description.en:
Sets a number placeholder for the next messages. Placeholders are filled in the text of the next messages: the value is stored under a key made from the kind and the index, which the message parser reads when it meets the matching tag in the text.
The key is REP_VAL_<index>.
Placeholder number used in the message text (0, 1, 2...).

Always null.
null if the script system is not ready or too few arguments are given.

examples.case: Showing a price and a reward in a question (real usage, from ev44029999.nut)
